    A few good questions

    Before your first small leap.

    No. Each course lists its starting level, tools and learning outcomes. Beginner courses are designed for a first project; more advanced courses build on existing practice.

    Yes. Every course has an illustrated sample classroom with a practical exercise, a short knowledge check and progress saved only on your browser. No account is required.

    Each course works towards a specific project, from an illustration series to an accessible interface. The course page and downloadable syllabus show the brief before you begin.

    Self-paced lessons let you pause and return. Cohort and live-session dates are shown separately, in your local timezone, with downloadable calendar files.

    You can practise the form and continue to a sample lesson. No payment is taken, no account is created and no email is sent. Connect your own services for a production site.
